in_arabic.name: صفية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني النقاء و الطهارة و الخلو من الشوب

in_urdu.name: صفیا
in_urdu.meaning: صفیا نام کا مطلب ہے خالص، پاک، اور بے داغ
in_urdu.long_meaning: اردو میں صفیا نام کا مطلب ہے خالص، پاک، اور بے داغ، جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جیسے کہ قرآن کریم میں مذکور ہے، یہ نام پاکیزگی، طہارت، اور ایمان کی خوبیوں کو ظاہر کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: सफिया
in_hindi.meaning: सफिया नाम का अर्थ है शुद्ध, पवित्र और निर्मल
in_hindi.long_meaning: सफिया नाम का अर्थ है शुद्ध, पवित्र और निर्मल, जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है और पवित्रता और आध्यात्मिक शुद्धता की विशेषताओं को दर्शाता है

in_pashto.name: صفیا
in_pashto.meaning: صفیا د نوم مطلب دی پاک، خالص او بې داغ
in_pashto.long_meaning: په پښتو کې صفیا د نوم مطلب دی پاک، خالص او بې داغ، دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، لکه څنګه چې په قرآن کریم کې ذکر شوی دی، دا نوم د پاکۍ، طهارت، او ایمان د ښه والي څرګندوي

in_english.name: Safiya
in_english.meaning: Safiya means pure, chaste, and free from impurities

It is a popular name among Muslims worldwide, symbolizing a person's commitment to a life of righteousness and moral integrity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Safiya holds a special place in Islamic culture, not only due to its meaning- 'pure and untainted', but also because it is the name of one of the Prophet Muhammad's most beloved wives. Safiya bint Huyayy ibn Akhtab was accepted into the Prophet's household after the Battle of Khaybar, and her beauty, intelligence, and piety became the subject of many hadiths, showcasing her prominent role in early Islamic history. Today, Safiya serves as an inspiration for Muslim women to strive for purity and righteousness in their daily lives.
data.spiritual_significance: For Muslims, the name Safiya holds deep spiritual significance, symbolizing the purity and closeness to Allah that every believer aspires to achieve. It is a reminder that no matter what external influences or adversities we may face, the essential goal is to maintain a heart free from sin and impurities. The Prophet Muhammad himself expressed the importance of this quality: "The believing man or woman keeps their heart free from Allah's displeasure as a falcon guarding its eggs." By bearing the name Safiya, one is continuously encouraged to strive towards this ideal.
